correctness.rationale: The mixed edge e={v,w} has cofaces exactly e∪T for T⊆N_F(w)∖{v}: the leaf cannot see another vertex across its shore, while the other endpoint sees exactly those additional neighbours. Fixing one of the d−1 extra neighbours as an apex pairs all 2^(d−1) cofaces including e; removing the pairs in descending order of the subset size makes each lower face free with precisely its designated codimension-one coface. The remaining subcomplex deletes exactly the faces forbidden by adding vw to H_F. Forest pruning preserves the number c of edge-containing components and reduces to a matching; the two contractible shore simplices then give S^0 for c=0 or two vertices with c joining edges after contraction for c≥1. Pendant pruning and failure of the deletion at a single isolated defect edge also follow.
residual_risks: The fresh checks are finite and the mod-two outputs cannot establish the general integral statement; the explicit collapse and matching calculation establish it.
